description_en: Refreshes the AccessToken credential for document preview
kebab_example: aliyun imm refresh-office-preview-token --project immdoctest --access-token f3a3ad0ae32a4c6fb90ed0021800000000 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RefreshOfficePreviewToken

parameters.help_en: The credential used to access the document preview server. You can obtain this credential by calling GetOfficePreviewURL or RefreshOfficePreviewToken
parameters.help_zh: 访问文档预览服务器的凭证，通过GetOfficePreviewURL或者RefreshOfficePreviewToken获取
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The RefreshToken used to refresh the credential when it expires. You can obtain this token by calling GetOfficePreviewURL or RefreshOfficePreviewToken
parameters.help_zh: 凭证过期时使用RefeshToken刷新凭证，通过GetOfficePreviewURL或者RefreshOfficePreviewToken获取
parameters.name: refresh_token

AccessToken.description_en: The credential used to access the document preview server
AccessToken.description_zh: 访问文档预览服务器的凭证

AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the credential. The credential is valid for 30 minutes
AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 凭证的过期时间，有效时间为30分钟

RefreshToken.description_en: The RefreshToken used to refresh the credential when it expires
RefreshToken.description_zh: 凭证过期时使用RefeshToken刷新凭证

RefreshTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the RefreshToken. The RefreshToken is valid for one day
RefreshTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 刷新凭证的过期时间，有效时间为1天
